originalTitle: Will the first EVs using sodium-ion battery technology ship in 2024?
title: 2024 年是否开始向付费客户交付钠离子汽车？
Did sodium-ion EV deliveries to paying customers begin in 2024?
rules: 正文以 FY2024 向付费客户交付、使用钠离子主电池为 Yes；原文将主电池要求写作“>10 kW”，12 V 辅助电池不算。
The description requires FY2024 paid-customer deliveries with sodium-ion traction; its primary-pack condition is written as “>10 kW”, excluding 12 V auxiliaries.
interpretation: 原文没有清楚定义 FY2024 的日历范围，且 kW 是功率单位，本站不擅自改成 kWh。
FY2024 dates are not fully defined and kW is power; this archive does not silently change it to kWh.

summary: 平台记录为 Yes，但原题对会计年度和主电池单位存在不够明确之处，适用范围与非锂主流车型题不同。
The source resolved Yes, while fiscal-year and pack-unit definitions remain imperfect and differ from the non-lithium major-model question.
checklist: 查看原市场交付与结算依据。
核对钠离子用于主动力。
保留 FY2024 和 >10 kW 原文疑点。

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 后续 CATL 资料解释钠离子产品路线，并不证明这道历史题涉及同一厂家或车型。页面将两种时间与对象并列，便于继续核对原市场的客户交付证据。
Later CATL material explains the technology, not that this historical contract concerned the same supplier or model. The page keeps object and time distinct for source-delivery review.
gap: 后续资料不是历史交付凭证。
Later material is not historical delivery evidence.

title: 钠离子材料、性能与实际交付
Sodium chemistry, performance and delivery
principle: 载流离子与正负极结构决定电池体系；电芯、整包与车型性能有不同分母。安全测试、技术发布和客户交付分别回答不同的问题。
Charge carriers and electrode structure define the chemistry. Cell, pack and vehicle metrics use different boundaries; safety tests, launches and delivery establish different facts.
example: CATL 公告的 175 Wh/kg 是比能量指标，超过 400 km 是车型续航表述；原题还要求零售客户交车。两者不能替代交付凭证。
CATL’s 175 Wh/kg is a specific-energy claim and over 400 km a vehicle claim. The contract additionally requires customer delivery records.

label: 原题口径说明
Source-rule scope
detail: 正文使用 FY2024 但未定义年度；主电池原文为 >10 kW，未替换成能量单位。
FY2024 is undefined and the primary pack uses >10 kW, not an assumed energy unit.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
